blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Actress Claudine Barretto filed a complaint against showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Wednesday afternoon, Oct. 21, for what she described as the “last straw” following the latter’s recent remarks against her. Barretto arrived at the NBI headquarters in Pasay City at around 2:09 p.m. accompanied by her lawyer, Atty. Lance Abrahm Mateo. According to Mateo, they will take their case to the NBI’s Cybercrime Division against Fermin and her co-host Romel Villamor, also known as Romel Chika.
